question: Should core permanently reserve the top-level `auth` CLI root even though current plugin registration skips installed plugin command groups with that root?
rationale: This convenience alias changes a documented plugin extension namespace, and source inspection cannot determine whether maintainers intend to trade existing plugin compatibility for the new command shape.

options.title: Keep the models namespace
options.body: Do not add the top-level root; retain `openclaw models auth list` as the canonical and compatibility-safe command.

options.title: Design shared-root composition
options.body: Pause the alias until core and plugin subcommands can coexist under `auth` with explicit compatibility, migration, and collision tests.

recommendation.title: Keep the models namespace
recommendation.body: Do not add the top-level root; retain `openclaw models auth list` as the canonical and compatibility-safe command.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin CLI architecture and existing duplicate-root behavior trace most directly to this history.
